mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in 60%+ of UNRATE < 4.0 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS growth above 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in 60%+ of joint HOUST/RSAFS above MA instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in 60%+ of FEDFUNDS > 4.5 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects stronger manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO > 12mo avg.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation above 3.0% triggers central bank hawkishness, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in 60%+ of CPIAUCSL inflation > 3.0% instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.5% signal a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in 60%+ of joint PAYEMS>100/UNRATE<4.5 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High-growth economic regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) support robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in 60%+ of GDPC1 growth > 2.0% instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
